item.worlddriver.marker.relabel: To change the label: look at a placed marker and type /worlddriver mark %s <label>
item.worlddriver.marker.screen: Right-click a placed one for the scene screen: name, box, save / place / run
screen.worlddriver.anchor.title: Scene anchor: %s
screen.worlddriver.anchor.name: Scene name
screen.worlddriver.anchor.rel: (offsets from the anchor; all zero means use the corner markers)
screen.worlddriver.anchor.badNumber: The box and the facing must be numbers
screen.worlddriver.anchor.needName: Give the scene a name first
screen.worlddriver.anchor.noCorners: No pair of corner markers around here encloses this anchor
item.worlddriver.marker.passable: Walk-through; other blocks can be placed over it; does not affect movement; keeps the water or lava it is placed into
item.worlddriver.marker_origin.tip: The scene's reference point; every position is saved relative to it
item.worlddriver.marker_origin.count: At most one, inside the area the two corners enclose; without one, the start is the origin
item.worlddriver.marker_origin.label: Label: the scene's name. Written on save; save / place / run then find the scene by it
item.worlddriver.marker_start.tip: Where the player stands when the test begins, facing south by default
item.worlddriver.marker_start.label: Label: with no origin marker, the scene's name lives here (written on save)
item.worlddriver.marker_goal.tip: A place the player must travel to
item.worlddriver.marker_goal.count: At least one; with several, the number at the start of the label sets the order, e.g. "2 near:1"
item.worlddriver.marker_goal.label: Label: block (default, step into this cell), near:<radius> (get within that distance), or y: (only reach this height)
item.worlddriver.marker_forbid.tip: A cell the player must never enter; entering it fails the test
item.worlddriver.marker_stand.tip: Where the player must be standing when the test ends: on solid ground, not in water
item.worlddriver.marker_watch.tip: After the test, the block in this cell is checked
item.worlddriver.marker_watch.label: Label: same (default, it must be unchanged), or the id of the block it must have become
item.worlddriver.marker_via.tip: A place the player must pass through, in order, on the way to the goal
item.worlddriver.marker_via.count: Any number, but only when there is exactly one goal
item.worlddriver.marker_via.label: Label: a number giving the order to pass them in
item.worlddriver.marker_pass.tip: A place the player must come near at least once; only checked, does not change the route
item.worlddriver.marker_pass.label: Label: a number, the distance in blocks that counts as "near" (default 1)
item.worlddriver.marker_corner.tip: One corner of the area that gets saved; the two corners define the whole area
item.worlddriver.marker_corner.count: Two per scene, at opposite corners
